description: x402 catalog report — the only graded census of the CDP Bazaar discovery index: every host we probed (727 on 2026-10-28), how many answer a live 402, the A-F grade for each with its defect ids, and the defect distribution across the whole market. Built for directory operators, facilitators, and anyone deciding which sellers to court or which tooling to build. Delivered as JSON with per-host rows so it drops straight into a pitch list or a board report.
name: akari_catalog_report
